image_description: A black wrought-iron bannister system on an outdoor staircase. The railing features a continuous top handrail with decorative scrollwork at the corners and ends, supported by vertical balusters that include both straight bars and ornamental curved elements. The structure follows the diagonal incline of the stairs and includes a thicker newel post at the corner turn.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific architectural classification and distinguish it from generic fences or gates.
To verify the 3D structural integrity of the railing against the stairs and ensure no floating elements or perspective warping.
To check for fusion artifacts where thin metal bars might bleed into the background or each other, a common AI failure mode.
To assess general sharpness, lighting consistency, and absence of subtle texture anomalies.

focus_areas: Continuity of the handrail at the corner joint
Structural connection points between balusters and handrail/base rail
Perspective consistency of the staircase steps relative to the railing
Edge sharpness of thin metal elements against the bright background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the handrail and the newel post at the corner; AI often fails to merge these cleanly. Also, verify that the bottom of the balusters connects logically to the stair treads or a base rail, rather than floating or merging into the steps.
